copy.heading: Your household: a who's who
body: During your posting some members of the household have changed. Children have been born. One of them can now ride a bike without stabilisers, and you missed it. The dog is a different dog. Please study the following introductions before tea, so that nobody has to wear a name badge again.

Sue. Your wife and case sponsor. Five foot four, hair up in a clip, usually holding a cup of tea she made two hours ago and has not had a chance to drink. She does the school run, the swimming run, the party run and a part-time job. Sue knows your handicap to one decimal place against her will.
Alfie. Your son, six. Can ride a bike, swim a width and recite the offside rule. He calls the golf club "Daddy's work". Nobody has corrected him.
Poppy. Your daughter, four. She calls you Golf Daddy, which you took as a compliment. It was an observation.
The dog. Answers to Biscuit. Has chewed one of your gloves, which you still mention, and which Sue says was the happiest day of the dog's life.
